commit_message: Expose ADR0127 Native2D MCP typed-document tools
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Fixes the exact d9eb5b9 affected Windows Validation MCP coverage failure by deriving Sprite Atlas, Sprite Animation, Tile Set, and Tile Map descriptors from the canonical capability registry. The existing headless handlers already execute these typed-document operations through the shared authoring service; tests now guard all four Native 2D domains.
